tldr_label: TL;DR — A strong jobs report lifts the odds of a Fed hike; Trump threatens to 'destroy' the rest of Iran; Russia fires 36 missiles at Kyiv

tldr_bullets.label: Jobs
tldr_bullets.body: The US added 165,000 jobs in October, far above forecasts, and unemployment fell to 4.1%. Markets now price roughly 77% odds of a Fed hike in December. [[TAG:warning:hike odds up]]

tldr_bullets.label: Markets
tldr_bullets.body: The Nasdaq and S&P 500 rebounded on Friday but posted weekly losses of about 3.4% and 2.7%. Brent ended near $98 after one of its steepest weekly drops since 2020.

tldr_bullets.label: Iran
tldr_bullets.body: Trump said he may have to 'destroy the rest' of Iran and would decide soon on resuming strikes. Iran's Revolutionary Guards say they downed a US drone over Qeshm. [[TAG:danger:strikes weighed]]

tldr_bullets.label: Ukraine
tldr_bullets.body: Zelensky says Russia fired 36 ballistic missiles at Kyiv overnight, damaging a major bridge. Trump says a peace deal is 'very close'. [[TAG:danger:36 missiles]]

tldr_bullets.label: Europe
tldr_bullets.body: The Bank of England raised its rate to 4%, citing energy prices. Hoax bomb threats disrupted flights across Europe for a second time this week.

tldr_bullets.label: Elections
tldr_bullets.body: Eisenkot is set to receive Israel's mandate on Sunday. Alaska's Senate race is still separated by a few hundred votes, and South Africa's ANC is near 31% with final results due Sunday.

sections.title: Jobs and the Fed
sections.summary: Payrolls jump 165,000 and unemployment falls to 4.1%, raising the odds of a December hike

paragraphs.heading: The report
paragraphs.body: CNBC reported that the economy added 165,000 jobs in October, far more than the roughly 59,000 expected, and that unemployment slipped to 4.1%. Morningstar and Fox Business carried the same headline figure. CNBC noted that the share of long-term unemployed rose to its highest since late 2021. [[TAG:success:+165K jobs]]

paragraphs.heading: Rates
paragraphs.body: The Rio Times reported that odds of a Fed hike in December rose to about 77%, and InvestmentNews said the report lifted those odds. Yahoo Finance said yields rose, and Pomegra put the 10-year Treasury yield near 4.87%. The next inflation report is due on November 10.

sections.sources: CNBC, Morningstar, Fox Business, Rio Times, InvestmentNews, Yahoo Finance, Pomegra

sections.title: Markets After the Rout
sections.summary: Tech rebounds on Friday but stocks post a losing week; Brent ends near $98

paragraphs.heading: Stocks
paragraphs.body: Yahoo Finance reported that the Nasdaq and S&P 500 rebounded on Friday while the Dow slipped, capping a bruising week for AI stocks. The Washington Post carried the index tally. StockTitan said chip stocks bounced back a day after their selloff. For the week, the S&P 500 lost about 2.7% and the Nasdaq about 3.4%.

paragraphs.heading: Oil
paragraphs.body: FinanceFeeds reported that Brent settled near $98.32 after what it called a 16% weekly drop. Investors King said Brent was heading for a decline of about 12%, so the size of the drop depends on the starting point. NBC News said prices had fallen below $100 on hopes of an end to the Iran war, and Yahoo Finance reported that Brent rose more than $3 on one day after tanker attacks. [[TAG:warning:oil volatile]]

sections.title: Iran
sections.summary: Trump says he may have to 'destroy the rest' of Iran as Tehran courts Moscow

paragraphs.heading: Threat
paragraphs.body: Al Jazeera reported that Trump said the US may have to 'destroy' the rest of Iran and that he would decide soon. The New Arab said diplomatic efforts are intensifying at the same time. Gulf News reported that Trump warned of a 'heavy hit'. Reports say Central Command is finalizing plans while Trump weighs resuming strikes, tightening sanctions or pursuing a deal. [[TAG:danger:strikes weighed]]

paragraphs.heading: Tehran
paragraphs.body: Al Jazeera's live blog reported that the Revolutionary Guards say they downed a US drone over Qeshm and that tankers were hit in Hormuz. It also reported that Iran's security chief met Putin and delivered a message from Khamenei. Dawn reported a separate claim that two drones were downed, so accounts differ.

sections.title: Ukraine
sections.summary: 36 ballistic missiles hit the Kyiv region and damage a key bridge; Trump says a deal is near

paragraphs.heading: Kyiv strike
paragraphs.body: The Kyiv Independent reported that Zelensky said 36 Russian ballistic missiles struck Kyiv and the surrounding region, damaging the Northern Bridge. Reuters, via Al Arabiya, reported casualties, and early counts differ, from several injured to one dead. Sigmalive said a kindergarten was damaged. The attack followed Zelensky's warning about strikes on energy and bridges. [[TAG:danger:36 missiles]]

paragraphs.heading: Diplomacy
paragraphs.body: Al Jazeera reported that Trump said a deal with Russia is 'very close' after meeting Putin's envoy Kirill Dmitriev, without giving specifics. Talks in Abu Dhabi are expected in the coming days.

sections.title: Europe
sections.summary: BoE raises its rate to 4% on energy costs; hoax bomb threats disrupt flights again

paragraphs.heading: Bank of England
paragraphs.body: The Bank of England said its Monetary Policy Committee voted 8-1 to raise Bank Rate by a quarter point to 4%, citing energy price pressure from the Middle East conflict. MoneyWeek covered the decision live. The next decision is due on December 17. [[TAG:warning:BoE hike]]

paragraphs.heading: Flight threats
paragraphs.body: CNBC and NPR reported repeated waves of hoax bomb threats against European flights this week, with diversions and fighter escorts, and NPR said broadcasters were also targeted. The Washington Post reported disruptions across several countries. Al Jazeera said the EU called it too early to say whether the threats are linked. Officials have warned about Russian hybrid threats but have not attributed these.

sections.title: Elections Pending
sections.summary: Eisenkot's mandate is due Sunday; Alaska's count drags on; South Africa's ANC is near 31%

paragraphs.heading: Israel
paragraphs.body: Israel National News and JNS reported that Herzog will assign the mandate on Sunday after 67 lawmakers recommended Eisenkot. Haaretz reported that Eisenkot signaled he is ready for a minority government, after Liberman ruled one out. [[TAG:info:mandate Sunday]]

paragraphs.heading: Alaska
paragraphs.body: Alaska's News Source reported that the Senate race remains undecided, with fewer than 700 votes separating Peltola and Sullivan. Reason argued that Peltola appears likely to win, while an Alaska Beacon analysis said ranked-choice redistribution could help Sullivan. Counting must finish by November 18. [[TAG:warning:too close]]

paragraphs.heading: South Africa
paragraphs.body: France 24 reported that the ANC is on track for 'nightmare' losses. BusinessTech said about 95% of votes are counted, with the ANC near 31% and the DA near 24%. The Citizen said the DA leads several metros, where coalitions will be needed. Final results are due on Sunday.
